description: This file implements a Kubernetes namespace filter for kustomize, handling namespace assignment, especially for role binding subjects, with special cases for default and service account subjects.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A filter for applying namespace modifications to Kubernetes resources, including handling role binding subjects.

methods.name: WithMutationTracker
methods.description: Registers a callback invoked on each mutation of the filter's fields.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Applies the namespace filter to a list of YAML nodes.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the namespace transformation on a single YAML node.

methods.name: metaNamespaceHack
methods.description: Handles namespace setting for metadata.namespace on namespace-scoped resources.

methods.name: roleBindingHack
methods.description: Handles setting namespace on subjects within RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding resources based on mode.

methods.name: isRoleBinding
methods.description: Checks if a resource kind is a RoleBinding or ClusterRoleBinding.

methods.name: setNamespaceField
methods.description: Sets the namespace field on a YAML node.

methods.name: removeRoleBindingSubjectFieldSpecs
methods.description: Removes hardcoded subject namespace field specifications for role bindings.

methods.name: removeUnneededMetaFieldSpecs
methods.description: Removes unnecessary metadata namespace or name field specifications based on API version.

methods.name: fieldSetter
methods.description: Returns a function to set or unset the namespace field.
